title: Thai Harees Biryani
description: A unique Thai twist on the traditional Indian harees dish, with the addition of aromatic spices and fresh herbs. This flavorful one-pot meal is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for another minute.
Add harees, bread, spice mix, chili flakes, sumac, and salt. Stir well.
Add 4 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in Thai basil and cook for another 5 minutes.
Fluff the harees mixture with a fork and serve hot.
Garnish with additional Thai basil and serve with a side of raita or chutney if desired.
